WE'RE PARTNERS.
NOT PASSENGERS
WE BACK YOU RIGHT FROM THE START

Our investment thesis is simple: we back exceptional founders,  sometimes before they even see it themselves, from pre-Seed to Series A+, building Digital, Climate, and Deep Tech startups that don’t just lead categories, but redefine them.

WE'RE NOT ON THE SIDELINES

As former founders and operators, we build with you every step of the way. With our scaling team as an extension of yours, we bring not just expertise and tactical insights, but a deep commitment to help you optimize operations and scale with confidence.

WE GO WHERE YOU ARE

With offices in London & Paris, and on the ground partners throughout Europe & Africa's main tech hubs - we think global and act local.

WE BACK FOR
